title: Chholay (Chickpea Curry)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: From the author's friend Ruchira Paul, simplified. Black tea and dried pomegranate deepen the sauce, and mashing some of the chickpeas thickens it. Best with fresh bread; rice also works.

steps.action: Heat in a large pot on medium-high (7/10), 3 min:
Add and fry 5 min, stirring often:
items: 2 medium onions (1 lb / 450 g total), chopped
1½ tsp salt (2 tsp if the stock is unsalted)
3 medium tomatoes, chopped (or 14 oz / 400 g can)
3 cans chickpeas (14 oz / 400 g each), drained
4 Tbsp dried pomegranate seeds (or 2 Tbsp pomegranate powder)

steps.action: Add and bring to a simmer; cover and simmer on medium-low (3/10) 15 min:
items: 2 cups beef stock (480 ml; chicken or vegetable ok)
1 cup brewed medium-strength unflavored black tea (240 ml; Assam, Ceylon, or English Breakfast)

steps.action: Mash about a quarter of the chickpeas against the pot with a spoon; stir.
Cover, turn off heat, and rest 5 min. Adjust salt and lime.

items: 3 green chilies, halved lengthwise (or 1 jalapeño, in rings)

edits: Source gives can size as 14 fl oz (400 ml); US cans are labeled by weight, about 15 oz
